title: Relayer
tagline: NFT Protocol (and marketplace) to create a new layer of creativity
description:
Relayer is the NFT protocol (and marketplace) to make NFTs great again. The concept is designed to reward the creativity and novelty.

How it works?
All the new NFTs minted on platform are considered as the layer 0 NFTs. Each NFT has 1000 fractions.

Anyone can purchase the fractions of 2 (or more) NFTs, to generate and mint a new Layer 1 NFT. This NFT will have 1000 shares, its price defined by the creator and a parent-children connection.

When someone purchases the NFT, it pays the creator, but it also rewards the original creator of the layer 0 NFT.
how_its_made: Relayer was made using NextJS, Solidity and MongoDB primarily. It uses Sign protocol to save the parent-children relation attestation off-chain, Dynamic wallet for signing in and Blockscout as the block explorer. The smart contract - frontend interaction is being handled using wagmi.
